# Dorothy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dorothy possesses roguish hazel eyes. Her appearance is otherwise noted to closely resemble [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), with her eye color serving as the primary distinction between them.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Dorothy Gardner is a slim individual with a jolly demeanor. She is also characterized as being rather tomboyish.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Traits

- jolly  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)</sub>
- tomboyish  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Dorothy visited [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with her brother [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) and their family, arriving a day earlier than anticipated and causing initial chaos. Despite the awkward start to the surprise visit, she formed a warm connection and bonded with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P31](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0031)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dorothy.md)

Dorothy is an intimate college friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their relationship begins when Dorothy visits Patty's Place a day early alongside her family, where the initially awkward visit ends with the two of them bonding. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) serves as a bridesmaid for Phil's wedding after returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following her breakup with Dorothy's brother, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), +8 more_

- Friend of — intimate college friends  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P33](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0033), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.Weddings P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)</sub>

### [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--roy-gardner.md)

Dorothy is the sister of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She travels alongside [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) and the rest of their family to visit Patty's Place a day earlier than announced, causing initial chaos before she ends up bonding with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), +3 more_
